plaques.text:
SHEPHERD'S REACH

High pasture under the glacier. Her calls carried three valleys.

THE COUNTING STONE

One pebble in the hollow for every ewe over the bridge.
Forty-three pebbles, and room in the hollow for one more.

THE COUNTING STONE

Nothing has come back over the bridge.
Every one of them is facing up the hill.

pickups.label: Take the bow off its peg
Look at the ewe
pickups.look: A ewe with a dark smear down her nose. She is the only one on the fell not facing the fold. She is facing the door.

pickups.label: Pry up what the frost holds

edges.doc: tools/audit_edges.py: the fold wall is a thicket; the beck drowns in THAW and is a floor in RIME; the bridge is a floor.
